name: 1N541
description: Germanium DO-7 signal diode with a lower 45V reverse rating than the 1N270/1N277 and the usual ~0.3V germanium forward drop at signal levels. General germanium detection, low-level rectification, and clipping. Banded end is the cathode.

DO-7.notes: small glass axial body; the band marks the cathode.

extra.Vf: ~0.3V at signal levels; 2.2V max @ IF=10mA (loose NOS max spec)

typical_application: General germanium detection, low-level rectification, and soft clipping where a low forward drop and modest voltage rating are enough.
gotchas: germanium NOS spread: the 2.2V-max Vf is a loose datasheet ceiling - real parts drop ~0.3V at signal currents; measure
lower 45V reverse rating than the 1N270/1N277 - watch reverse voltage in clipping/detector use
